The production capacity planning task succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating effective use of the LangChain graph framework.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.80 across one trial with zero exceptions. The pytest suite in 'test_output.py' passed successfully, confirming the logic met the task requirements within a 3m 42s runtime. Future iterations should reuse the current graph structure but re-check edge case assumptions that may have limited the judge reward to 0.80.
